name: Venomancer: Brood Trap places the live Brood Egg model
contract: Brood Trap (803525) is a Spider Form (800841) ability whose effect 0 summons creature 52121 in front of the caster. The live client creature cache, the Exiles DB and the db.exil.es dump all record 52121 as 'Brood Egg' with display 412059 (8bl_aqir_eggs01.m2), which the installed client and the server CreatureDisplayInfo both carry. The trap must place a creature 52121 whose template model is 412059, not the spider egg 23058 (G_EggSpider.mdx). The 412059 model's bounding box is 5.3 yards wide, and no live source records a scale; compared in game against live arena footage (2026-08-01), the placed egg is drawn at object scale 0.4.
